checklists.checklist_title: Isuzu Truck Daily Driver Checklist & Report
checklists.frequency: Before the first trip each day

items.label: Tyres and wheels
items.description: Look for visibly low or damaged tyres, loose wheel parts, or missing wheel nuts. Do not attempt repairs.

items.label: Leaks or visible damage
items.description: Look under the vehicle and around the body for fresh leaks or damage.

items.label: Lights and indicators
items.description: Check headlights, indicators, hazard lights, brake lights, and reflectors.

items.label: Visibility
items.description: Check mirrors, windscreen, wipers, and washers are usable and clear.

items.label: Load and doors
items.description: Confirm the load is secure and doors, tailgate, and access steps are safe.

items.label: Seat belt
items.description: Check the seat belt is present and fastens correctly.

items.label: Dashboard warnings
items.description: After starting, note any warning light or message that remains on.

items.label: Horn
items.description: Check that the horn works.

items.label: Brakes and steering feel
items.description: At low speed in a safe area, note any unusual brake response, steering, vibration, or noise.

items.label: Fuel and AdBlue / DEF
items.description: Confirm there is enough fuel and exhaust fluid for the planned trip.

items.label: Engine oil and filter
items.description: Drain and replace engine oil and oil filter to the manufacturer specification.

items.label: Fuel filter and sedimenter
items.description: Service or replace filters as required; drain water from the sedimenter and prime the fuel system.

items.label: Air intake filter
items.description: Inspect the air filter and housing; clean or replace as required.

items.label: Fluids and leaks
items.description: Check coolant, brake, clutch, steering, transmission, and differential fluids; inspect for leaks.

items.label: Chassis lubrication
items.description: Lubricate service points according to the vehicle maintenance schedule.

items.label: Belts and hoses
items.description: Inspect condition, security, and tension; replace damaged components as authorized.

items.label: Battery and charging
items.description: Inspect terminals and mounting; test battery and charging system where required.

items.label: Brakes and air system
items.description: Inspect brake pads or linings, discs or drums, parking brake, and air system; record defects.

items.label: Tyres and wheel fasteners
items.description: Check tyre condition and wear; verify wheel fasteners using the approved procedure and torque specification.

items.label: Suspension and steering
items.description: Inspect springs, dampers, joints, steering links, and mounts for wear or damage.

items.label: Lights and electrical items
items.description: Verify exterior lights, indicators, warning lamps, horn, and relevant electrical connections.

items.label: Exhaust and emissions system
items.description: Inspect exhaust security and visible leaks; check DPF / emissions warnings where fitted.

items.label: Post-service leak and warning check
items.description: Run the engine and recheck for leaks, abnormal noise, and warning lights.

items.label: Road test
items.description: Complete a controlled road test when safe and authorized; record any remaining concern.

items.label: Vehicle ready for release
items.description: Confirm tools and materials are removed and any outstanding defect is documented.
